text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer! Now that the break's over, let's get to training!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And wouldn't you know, I've prepared the perfect divination technique for this very purpose! Here goes…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: All righty! Look at the angle of my arms! This is what you've gotta do to separate wooden chopsticks perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Training is gonna go pretty well today, I'm sure of it!
